summary_en: ¥80/share (end); ¥150/share (full year) — prior guidance ¥70 end, ¥140 full year. Policy floor ¥120/share; 40%+ total payout ratio (dividend + buyback). Concurrent buyback up to ¥10bn authorized.
title_en: Notice of Revision (Increase) to Dividend Forecast for the Fiscal Year Ending December 2026
translation_en_brief: DIC Corporation revised upward its dividend forecast for fiscal year 2026 (ending December 2026) at a board meeting on 10 August 2026. The interim dividend (second quarter) remains ¥70/share. The year-end dividend is increased from ¥70/share to ¥80/share, making the full-year dividend ¥150/share versus the prior guidance of ¥140/share. This revision reflects full-year operating results expected to exceed the initial plan across all profit metrics. The company operates under a shareholder return policy announced 16 February 2026, which sets a dividend floor of ¥120/share and targets a total payout ratio of 40% or higher, with dividends as the primary mechanism and opportunistic share buybacks to support capital returns. Alongside the dividend increase, the board simultaneously authorized a share buyback programme with an upper limit of ¥10bn, detailed in a companion disclosure on the same date.
